svg.title: One memory for all your AIs
svg.desc: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Kimi Code are wired to the Nestor cloud. Claude Code adds the task book hotel, Cursor asks what is next and gets it, Codex marks it done and Kimi Code finds the Lisbon notes: for a trip, a building site or a project, every agent shares the same tasks, notes, projects and history.
